description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Start inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Machine_Type" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Serial_Number" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Answer_Inspection_Questions" name="Answer inspection questions and enter values"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Press_Machine_Buttons" name="Press machine buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Collect_And_Show_Values" name="Automatically collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Additional_Questions" name="Do the results call for additional questions?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Answer_Additional_Questions" name="Answer additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Type" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Enter_Machine_Type"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Serial" sourceRef="Enter_Machine_Type" targetRef="Enter_Serial_Number"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Serial_Questions" sourceRef="Enter_Serial_Number" targetRef="Answer_Inspection_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Questions_Buttons" sourceRef="Answer_Inspection_Questions" targetRef="Press_Machine_Buttons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buttons_Values" sourceRef="Press_Machine_Buttons" targetRef="Collect_And_Show_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Values_Decision" sourceRef="Collect_And_Show_Values" targetRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Questions" name="Results call for additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Answer_Additional_Questions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">results indicate additional questions are needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No_Additional_Questions" name="Results do not call for additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">results do not indicate additional questions are needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_To_Merge" sourceRef="Answer_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_To_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
